name: Reposition makes target unit distant
notes: Reposition's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 1-reserve cost is paid, then both players decline the EffectStackActiveResponse opportunity window before the seeded Dungeon Guide is chosen as the target. Making it distant adds the DISTANT turn-effect tag (alongside the engine's own ENTERED_THIS_TURN tag from being freshly seeded onto the field this turn).
